primary_sources: Pazos M, Traverso CE, Viswanathan A; European Glaucoma Society. Terminology and guidelines for glaucoma, 6th edition. Br J Ophthalmol 2025;109(Suppl 1):1-212
Gedde SJ, Vinod K, Wright MM, et al. Primary open-angle glaucoma preferred practice pattern. Ophthalmology 2021;128(1S):P71-P150
Viswanathan AC, Crowston JG, Strouthidis NG, et al. Simplifying 'target' intraocular pressure for different stages of primary open-angle glaucoma. Indian J Ophthalmol 2018;66(4):495-505

stage_definitions.OHT: Ocular Hypertension — IOP elevated, no glaucomatous damage
stage_definitions.Mild: Mild POAG (Early) — VF MD better than -6 dB, no central threat
stage_definitions.Moderate: Moderate POAG — VF MD between -6 and -12 dB
stage_definitions.Severe: Severe / Advanced POAG — VF MD worse than -12 dB or central involvement
stage_definitions.NTG: Normal-Tension Glaucoma — POAG with baseline IOP <= 21 mmHg

rules.name: Stage-based baseline target IOP range
rules.specification: Assigns baseline target IOP range based on glaucoma stage classification

thresholds.NTG: 10-12 mmHg (or 30% reduction from baseline if available)

rules.implementation_note: Ranges derived from EGS 2025 stage-specific recommendations and the Viswanathan simplified framework. NTG ranges assume LoGTS-style aggressive lowering.

rules.name: CCT modifier application
rules.specification: Adjusts the target IOP range based on CCT label, biasing toward lower target if thin CCT and toward upper target if thick CCT

thresholds.thin: Bias target to lower portion of range (more aggressive)
thresholds.thick: Bias target to upper portion of range (less aggressive)

rules.implementation_note: CCT is incorporated as a categorical modifier, not as a numeric correction of measured IOP. Individual corneal biomechanical properties are not accounted for.

rules.name: Progression-based escalation
rules.specification: Lowers target IOP range when documented progression is present
logic: If progression == 'stable': use baseline range from M2-R01
If progression == 'documented': shift range 2-3 mmHg lower
If progression == 'aggressive': shift range to severe-stage range regardless of current stage
rules.implementation_note: Progression input may be supplied directly by clinician or derived from M3/M4 outputs in M5 integration.

rules.name: Anchor-mode disclosure
rules.specification: Records and discloses which clinical anchor was used to set the target
anchor_modes: guideline_default — used baseline range from stage classification
percent_reduction — 30% reduction from baseline IOP applied (NTG default)
progression_escalated — range shifted lower due to progression input
cct_modulated — range adjusted based on CCT label
rules.implementation_note: Anchor mode is propagated to M5 logic_trace for full auditability of how the target was determined.

rules.name: Severe-stage central threat modifier
rules.specification: When central threat to fixation is documented, sets target to lowest range regardless of MD-based stage
rules.implementation_note: Central threat triggers the most aggressive target band, reflecting the clinical priority of preserving central vision.

rules.name: Functionally-monocular stricter target
rules.specification: When the eye is functionally monocular (contralateral eye visually impaired), shifts target band one stage lower than current stage classification
rules.implementation_note: Reflects the clinical principle of greater protection for the only seeing eye.

rules.name: Confidence level derivation
rules.specification: Assigns M2 confidence based on stage clarity and modifier presence
logic: If stage classification is clear AND no escalation modifiers: confidence = 'high'
If stage borderline OR one escalation modifier active: confidence = 'moderate'
If stage unclear AND multiple modifiers active: confidence = 'low'
rules.implementation_note: M2 confidence is propagated to M5 as one of the inputs determining the integrated confidence level.
